steps.name: Restore compiled Rust dependencies
Install captured Rust compiler namespace
steps.run:
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install --yes bubblewrap
sudo sysctl -w kernel.apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns=0

steps.name: Install pinned validation and guest tools
steps.run:
python3 -m pip install --requirement tools/requirements.lock
python3 tools/install_guest_bindgen.py "$RUNNER_TEMP/guest-tools"
echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/guest-tools" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
cargo fetch --locked

steps.name: Test standalone validation and process ownership
Test captured Rust executable-input approvals and namespace
Test captured Rust fault and fresh-invocation protocol boundaries
Test bounded Rust original-core and native FFI diagnostic boundaries
Test reviewed Rust dependency authoring and selected frontend
Qualify proposed transaction shapes with the maintained Rust compiler and HTTP preparation
steps.run:
python3 tools/generate_transaction_contracts.py --check
python3 tools/qualify_transaction_contracts.py --language rust --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/transaction-contract-rust"
cargo test --locked -p latent-wasmtime --lib values::tests::transactions -- --nocapture

steps.name: Compile the authored transaction aggregate and forbidden immediate HTTP variant
Count actual guest command executions, commits and effects under duplicate delivery
steps.run:
set -o pipefail
cargo --config .cargo/managed-guest.toml test --locked -p latent-wire --lib phase4::local_transaction::tests:: -- --ignored --test-threads=1 --nocapture 2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/transaction-guests-rust/node-dedup-executions.log"

steps.name: Preserve typed host-result uncertainty and original technical aborts
steps.run:
cargo --config .cargo/managed-guest.toml test --locked -p latent-executor --lib tests::existing_report_constructors_keep_host_result_observed -- --exact
cargo --config .cargo/managed-guest.toml test --locked -p latent-node --lib transaction_runtime::tests::technical_abort:: -- --test-threads=1 --nocapture
cargo --config .cargo/managed-guest.toml test --locked -p latent-node --lib activation_runner::diagnostics::tests::codec_metadata_alone_never_classifies_guest_traps -- --exact

steps.name: Execute complete outside-checkout authoring qualification
Qualify captured Rust libraries and approved generators
Test native Cargo declaration and lock authoring boundaries
Qualify authenticated private Cargo capture and offline signed execution
Verify published private archive semantics with locked offline Cargo metadata
Exercise developer cache with the actual operator and compiled Rust package inputs
Test contract derivation and isolated provenance approvals
steps.run:
cargo test --locked -p latent-packaging semantics::authoring
cargo test --locked -p latent-signing --test guest_provenance
